x-agent-guidelines.purpose: Standard instructions for AI/coding agents when creating or updating this project.
x-agent-guidelines.scope: Jejakawan CMS; repo ja-cms (Visual Builder, Publishing, Layout, Themes, Media, Forms, Library, and Intelligence).
when_creating_or_updating_project: Read docs/AGENT_START_HERE.md and docs/product/control-plane-and-editions.md first, then docs/.agent-rules.md, docs/architectural-status.md, docs/blueprint/*, and docs/plan/module-communication-standard.md. Use only paths listed in docs/README.md.
For UI/UX changes read docs/blueprint/03-ui-ux-design-system.md and docs/blueprint/04-ui-ux-page-patterns.md.
Use branch-based workflow; avoid direct edits on main.
Prefer package managers for dependency changes (npm/composer), avoid manual lockfile edits.
Keep changes minimal and focused; avoid unrelated refactors.
Do not commit secrets or environment-specific credentials.
After edits, run quality gates before proposing merge.
handover_checklist: Summarize risky files touched and behavior changes.
Ensure working tree is clean before final handover.
